mapper.select: select id, dept_name as deptName from department order by id
select id, major_name as majorName, dept_id as deptId from major where dept_id = #{deptId}
select id, class_name as className, major_id as majorId from sys_class where major_id = #{majorId}
select c.id, c.class_name as className, c.major_id as majorId from sys_class c inner join major m on c.major_id = m.id where m.dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.update: update department set dept_name = #{deptName} where id = #{id}
update major set major_name = #{majorName} where id = #{id}
update sys_class set class_name = #{className} where id = #{id}
